reason: The free first visit lets me check how clean it really is and see if the Baby Nook keeps my 10-month-old away from the bigger kids. If it passes, a weekday visit at $13 with my baby free is something I could stretch to a couple of times a month.
objection: Will the 4-year-old's age group be running wild near my baby, and is the cleaning log real or just a sign on the wall? Also $13 adds up fast on our budget.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the Baby Nook and cleaning log in person on the free visit, with a real cap on kids at once. If it's crowded or grimy I'm out.
